article_title: White House bars CNN from travelling with Trump on Air Force One

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: CNN was excluded from travelling with President Trump amid a wider dispute over White House media access.
CNN cancelled all reporting from Washington because of a technical problem.
The White House ended the practice of allowing any journalists on Air Force One.
President Trump cancelled his trip to Tennessee after a court ruling.
tasks.correct_answer: CNN was excluded from travelling with President Trump amid a wider dispute over White House media access.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בהוצאת CNN מרשימת כלי התקשורת לטיסה עם הנשיא, כחלק מעימות רחב יותר על גישת עיתונאים לבית הלבן.

tasks.prompt: How did CNN learn it was no longer scheduled to travel on Air Force One?
options: A judge announced it during a hearing.
A White House note released on Friday night did not list CNN on the media schedule.
Another television network replaced CNN during a live broadcast.
The airline told CNN that the flight had been cancelled.
tasks.correct_answer: A White House note released on Friday night did not list CNN on the media schedule.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: CNN הייתה אמורה להצטרף לטיסה, אך שמה לא הופיע בהודעת לוח הזמנים התקשורתי שפרסם הבית הלבן ביום שישי בלילה.

tasks.prompt: What does “tentative schedule” mean in this report?
options: A schedule approved permanently by a court
A secret list available only to federal officials
A provisional schedule that may still change
A timetable created by the television networks
tasks.correct_answer: A provisional schedule that may still change
tasks.explanation_hebrew: tentative פירושו זמני או לא סופי; לוח הזמנים עדיין עשוי להשתנות.

tasks.prompt: Which outlets had Trump previously banned from the White House?
options: ABC, CBS and NBC
BBC, Reuters and Fox News
CNN, Fox News and Politico
CNN, Politico and MS NOW
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שטראמפ אסר קודם לכן על עיתונאים מ־CNN, Politico ו־MS NOW להיכנס לבית הלבן.

tasks.prompt: How did four television networks show solidarity with the banned outlets?
options: They paused their broadcasts of the president.
They replaced CNN on Air Force One.
They launched a joint government streaming channel.
They refused to cover the Tennessee football game permanently.
tasks.correct_answer: They paused their broadcasts of the president.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ABC, CBS, Fox News ו־NBC עצרו זמנית את שידורי הסיקור של הנשיא כאות סולידריות עם כלי התקשורת שנאסרו.

tasks.prompt: Why is the federal judge's ruling important to the story?
options: It decided which college football team could host the president.
It required every network to travel on Air Force One.
It suggested the media ban was likely unconstitutional and required access to be restored for now.
It allowed the White House to replace all television coverage with Trump TV.
tasks.correct_answer: It suggested the media ban was likely unconstitutional and required access to be restored for now.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: פסק הדין חשוב מפני שהוא קבע שהאיסור כנראה אינו חוקתי והורה לאפשר לכלי התקשורת לחזור, לפחות זמנית.

tasks.prompt: Give two actions taken by media organisations in response to the White House restrictions.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי תגובות שונות של כלי התקשורת ולתאר בקצרה מה הייתה מטרת כל תגובה.
expected_points: CNN, Politico and MS NOW said they were pursuing legal action.
The outlets argued that their free-speech and press rights had been violated.
ABC, CBS, Fox News and NBC paused presidential coverage in solidarity.
Regular television coverage resumed after reporters were allowed back inside.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article show that the access dispute was not fully resolved after the court order?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להביא לפחות שני פרטים שמראים פער בין פסק הדין לבין הגישה בפועל.
expected_points: CNN was still removed from the Air Force One media schedule.
Some CNN and MS NOW reporters were denied entry to cover arrivals at the state dinner for Xi Jinping.
The White House continued to argue that reporters do not have unrestricted access to every event.
Coverage resumed in some settings, but restrictions continued in others.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the events that led from the original media ban to CNN's exclusion from Air Force One.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את האיסור המקורי, תגובת כלי התקשורת, פסק הדין והוצאת CNN מלוח הטיסה.
expected_points: Trump barred journalists from CNN, Politico and MS NOW after accusing them of false reporting.
The outlets considered legal action and other networks paused coverage in solidarity.
A federal judge said the ban was likely unconstitutional and ordered access restored for now.
Despite that ruling, CNN was omitted from the Air Force One media schedule for the Tennessee trip.

tasks.prompt: Using evidence from the article, explain why access to presidential events matters for freedom of the press.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג טענה ברורה, להשתמש בשתי ראיות לפחות מן הכתבה ולהסביר את הקשר בין גישה פיזית לאירועים לבין יכולת לסקר את הנשיא.
expected_points: Travelling with the president and entering official events allow reporters to observe and question government actions.
Excluding selected outlets can limit their ability to report at the same time as competitors.
The outlets linked the restrictions to constitutional freedoms of speech and the press.
The judge's ruling indicates that selective access can raise constitutional concerns.
The solidarity action by other networks shows that the issue affected the wider press corps.
